title: MemoryGrantsGrantResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "grant_id": string, "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.grants.grant (§7.9): NOT_AUTHORIZED, INVALID_INPUT, SPACE_FROZEN, SUBJECT_FENCED. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
